gen-gf-kavivanar-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab stretches each word out wide, its open counters breathing and its strokes never shifting weight, like a classic serif bent from wire. Kavivanar's hand-drawn heading loosens it, so a long read feels dignified yet friendly.
gen-gf-kavivanar-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru lets its terminals stop well away from the stem and spaces its letters generously, giving an editorial, traditional tone. Kavivanar's relaxed handwriting sits above it, making a longer stretch of text feel warm rather than stiff.
gen-gf-kavivanar-gf-orbit: Orbit keeps each character floating apart, its curves stopping short of closing, with every stem and tail drawn like rope. Next to Kavivanar's loose handwriting, it feels cool and tidy against something friendly.
gen-gf-kavivanar-gf-padyakke-expanded-on: A stroke that never changes thickness runs through Kavivanar, with s endings that flare open like a quick pen flick. Padyakke Expanded One answers in a wide text serif, its glyphs spread out like knots on a slack rope, so the page feels both casual and authoritative.
gen-gf-kavivanar-gf-syncopate: Wide and technical, Syncopate draws its open c, e and s shapes with a steady pen and spaces them like rope-ladder rungs. Under Kavivanar's handwriting, give this sans-serif a modest size.
gen-gf-kavivanar-manrope: Kavivanar draws every letter with one steady stroke, and its lowercase s flares open at the ends like a quick hand sketch. Manrope follows as a plain sans with bright open curves and a minimal step from capitals to lowercase, which is the friendliest thing about the pair.
gen-gf-kavivanar-montserrat: Montserrat leads with plenty of white space going into each curve, and its oversized e and a counters glide along like wire. Make Kavivanar's handwriting small and it loses its warmth, so keep the plain sans body from growing large beside it.
gen-gf-kavivanar-satoshi: Kavivanar's strokes hold one constant thickness from top to baseline, giving every letter a relaxed, hand-drawn look. Satoshi rises with a soaring x-height and a wide-open e, so a long page feels approachable and unhurried.
gen-gf-kavivanar-switzer: Wiry and tall, Switzer has tubular letterforms with c tips that never drift toward touching, set under Kavivanar's loose hand-drawn lines. Over a long page, that plain sans stays approachable and Swiss in temperament.
gen-gf-kavivanar-work-sans: Loose hand, crisp frame. Kavivanar is at its best with relaxed, friendly headings drawn in a single stroke, while Work Sans is at its best carrying contemporary body text, with open c tips and a high mean line.
